scope: Curve/ruled-surface seam unification and overlap parameter correspondence (follow-up to brep-curve-ruled-surface-v1): geometric U-seam closure detection on the canonical ruled-in-V orientation by exact homogeneous proportionality of the seam ruling polygons, parameter-based unification of seam-side point events to a canonical u=u_min representative, wrapped overlap components across the seam (seamWrap), and a sampled per-parameter correspondence on overlaps (three exact (t,u,v) triples at curve-interval fractions 0, 1/2, 1 reconstructing the Möbius t->v cross-ratio map along a ruling or the affine t->u map along an iso-V directrix); additive serialization only, TS adapter and WASM fixtures extended

RESOLVED curve lying on the seam ruling (x=2, y=0, z in [1,3]) with equal and with 3x unequal endpoint weights: a single overlap with curveInterval [0,1], canonical u=0 path, seamWrap=true, and a mobius_v correspondence whose cross-ratio-reconstructed map matches direct surface evaluation at seven interior parameters to 1e-9; sample V endpoints match the independent Möbius lift to 1e-9
RESOLVED iso-V quarter-arc overlap on an open ruled patch: affine_u correspondence, seamWrap=false, affine reconstruction matches direct evaluation at five interior parameters to 1e-9

WASM roundtrip: seam-crossing chord through the packed kernel reports one seam event; seam endpoint fixture unifies to uv=(0,0) exactly; perturbed seam reports incomplete with both near_coincidence bands; mobius_v and affine_u correspondence fields roundtrip through JSON and reconstruct against evaluateNurbsSurface/evaluateNurbsCurve at five interior parameters each to 1e-9

REGRESSION all existing curve_ruled_surface tests pass unchanged (line through ruled plane, cylinder piercing in both orientations, ruling and iso-V overlaps, misses, corner contacts, knot shift/scale, reversal, tangency/budget/unsupported refusal)
behaviorChange: Additive only: overlap components gain seamWrap (boolean) and correspondence (null or {kind: 'mobius_v'|'affine_u', samples: three [t,u,v] triples}); point events on an exactly closed seam may fold to a canonical u=u_min representative; near-closed seams now report explicit near_coincidence seam bands (coverage becomes incomplete where duplicates were previously silent). No existing query, op, adapter signature or budget changed; permitsTopologyChange stays false

limits.seamClosure: exact homogeneous proportionality of the two seam ruling polygons (bitwise after the dominant-component ratio, positive scale); relative mismatch within 1e-6 is near-closed (duplicates + unresolved bands), larger is open
limits.seamMergeRule: point events merge only when both isolating boxes touch the two domain ends exactly, curve-parameter intervals touch and V boxes overlap; overlap merge requires touching curve intervals and exactly equal lifted V endpoints (ruling pair) or an exact u_max->u_min path joint (iso-V chain)
limits.canonicalSeamRepresentative: u = u_min; wrapped iso-V paths keep source knot coordinates with seamWrap=true
limits.correspondenceEncoding: three exact (t,u,v) samples at curve-interval fractions 0, 1/2, 1; mobius_v reconstructs v(t) by the cross-ratio identity (v-v0)(v1-v2)/((v-v2)(v1-v0)) = (t-t0)(t1-t2)/((t-t2)(t1-t0)), affine_u reconstructs u(t) linearly; null when a seam merge joins pieces with different maps

limitations: Only ruled surfaces are admitted; general CS against arbitrary NURBS surfaces, analytic SS pairs and certified tangency remain open (unchanged from the previous slice)

Events resolved from only one seam side keep their resolving-side parameter (u near u_max); only confirmed two-sided seam contacts fold to the canonical u=u_min — one-sided resolution is a Newton artifact, not a guess

Pre-existing Newton limits surfaced during this slice: an iterate landing bitwise on a C0 double knot has missing one-sided jets and the box fails into an explicit near_coincidence band (observed for unequal-weight crossings at u=1/2 knots); a transverse root lying bitwise on a subdivision box boundary can be left silent by every adjacent terminal box (documented silent-outside rule) — native oracles therefore use non-dyadic crossing parameters
Correspondence is null where a seam merge joins pieces whose parameter maps differ (piecewise maps are not sampled); multi-span iso-V overlaps are not chained except across the exact seam wrap

Seam closure is exact-bitwise after scaling: a legitimate seam whose homogeneous rows differ by a non-dyadic scale factor (1-ulp rounding) classifies as near-closed and reports unresolved seam bands rather than merging
NumericallyResolved is not certified complete-domain coverage and permitsTopologyChange stays false
